name: Play the imprint land as my land drop and exile the huge colorless card so it taps for two
intent: Applies on a mana-poor turn - one untapped source or none before the land drop - when my hand holds the land whose imprint trigger exiles a colorless card with mana value 7 or greater, at least one such card, and a two-mana artifact rock. Playing the land and accepting the imprint makes it add {C}{C} instead of {C}, which is the only way a two-mana rock is deployed off a single land. The imprint answer selects colorless, mana value 7 or greater, and prefers the largest first - 13, then 10 or more, then 8 or more, then any 7 - because the point is to bank the card that stays uncastable longest; the land's third ability returns it to hand later, so nothing is lost. The caveat the hand-played line obeyed is encoded twice: mana value 7 or greater is by itself uncastable this turn or next at one or two lands, and the two-mana artifact condition means the extra {C} is actually spent this turn rather than floated. The untapped_mana ceiling of 1 is also what keeps this play and the land-search artifact play disjoint - that one requires two untapped mana to crack, this one requires at most one - so at most one of the two applies at any single decision point.
